_meta.contract: each entry is one test: build `case`, ask `ask`, assert `expect_kernel`
_meta.row_form:
every row has `id`, `kind`, `signer`, `names` (the ids it names) and `family`. Kinds:
    keyrec     a key's own record (`identity_type`, and `node` for a component of a node); admitted by possession
    offer, accept, withdraw, unseat, cosign
               the seat rows of formal/causal_kernel/seat.py, with its fields (`to`, `scope`, `obj`, `conf`,
               `under`, `cosigners`, `head`, `policy`, `cuts`, `on`)
    fam        a row of the family the parameter governs, or of another family the case needs; fields the gate reads:
               `subject`, `subjects`, `group`, `root`, `content`, `blob`, `for_key`, `binding`, `provenance`,
               `build_manifest_hash`, `head`, `leaf`, `ref`, `at` (a signed instant, read only by a shipped fold)
    landing, reversal, claim, trust
               a window's landing, a row voiding a notice, a source's statement, a reader's trust edge
A `withdraw` or `recant` naming a `fam` row of the governed family is judged by the parameter's lifecycle.

verdicts.state: admitted | concludes nothing | withdrawn | recanted | refused | waits

returns: To return an entry whose verdict you hold wrong, add a row to `formal/derivation/divergence_returns.tsv` with the entry's `id`, your implementer name, the date, what it `disputes` (case, expect_kernel or sentence), your counter-case as JSON rows in `counter_rows` with `counter_ask`, `their_verdict`, a one-line `reason` and `outcome` open. The entry then reads `disputed`, the kernel's verdict on your counter-case is recorded beside yours, and the text or the model is corrected or the entry stands.

not_runnable.reason: a stalled roster (T7) is no answer of the kernel model and no condition of the guard grammar; its condition reads a count of active founders over a margin (a named limit in CC 8.3.4)
not_runnable.quote: So a stalled roster admits **exactly one row kind without that count**: a widening whose only change is the addition of a **founder** seat.
